answer: Entry-attestation plus cluster detection. Before a new account earns, it needs attestations from several established accounts far apart in the graph, forcing real cross-links, not kin-only. Behavior catches the rest: a clone ring behaves like a raven flock - near-identical phrasing, synchronized timing, correlated grades - and panels flag the whole grove, slashing shared bonds. Registration runs through a trellis of such checks at join, first payout, and renewal; evasion must pass all three gates. Weak point: operators diversify per-clone style; weight timing correlation above wording.
